description: This file implements the 'mod_status' module for Lighttpd, providing server status and statistics via HTTP endpoints. It includes functions for initializing, configuration merging, generating HTML/text/JSON responses, and handling server trigger and request completion events.

classes.name: plugin_config
classes.description: Stores configuration parameters for the mod_status plugin, including URLs for status, config, statistics, and a sorting flag.

classes.name: plugin_data
classes.description: Contains runtime data for the plugin, including metrics on traffic, requests, and per-interval sliding averages.

methods.name: mod_status_init
methods.description: Allocates and initializes the plugin_data structure.

methods.name: void mod_status_merge_config_cpv(plugin_config * const pconf,const config_plugin_value_t * const cpv)
methods.description: Merges configuration key-value pairs into plugin_config structure.

methods.name: void mod_status_merge_config(plugin_config * const pconf,const config_plugin_value_t * cpv)
methods.description: Processes an array of configuration key-value pairs and merges them into plugin_config.

methods.name: void mod_status_patch_config(request_st * const r,const plugin_data * const p,plugin_config * const pconf)
methods.description: Applies configuration patches for a specific request, considering conditions.

methods.name: mod_status_set_defaults
methods.description: Sets default configuration values and initializes plugin configuration based on global config.

methods.name: void mod_status_header_append_sort(buffer * b,const plugin_config * const pconf,const char * k,size_t klen)
methods.description: Appends HTML for sortable table header based on configuration.

methods.name: void mod_status_get_multiplier(buffer * b,double avg,int size)
methods.description: Converts a numerical value into a human-readable scaled unit, formatting the output.

methods.name: void mod_status_html_rtable_r(buffer * const b,const request_st * const r,const unix_time64_t cur_ts)
methods.description: Generates an HTML table row with detailed connection/request information.

methods.name: void mod_status_html_rtable(request_st * const rq,const server * const srv,const unix_time64_t cur_ts)
methods.description: Generates the complete connection status table in HTML by iterating over all connections.

methods.name: handler_t mod_status_handle_server_status_html(server * srv,request_st * const r,const plugin_data * const p,const plugin_config * const pconf)
methods.description: Handles the request for server status page in HTML format, including server uptime, requests, traffic, and connection info.

methods.name: handler_t mod_status_handle_server_status_text(server * srv,request_st * const r,const plugin_data * const p)
methods.description: Handles server status request and outputs plain text metrics.

methods.name: handler_t mod_status_handle_server_status_json(server * srv,request_st * const r,const plugin_data * const p)
methods.description: Outputs server status and metrics in JSON format, supporting JSONP callback.

methods.name: handler_t mod_status_handle_server_statistics(request_st * const r)
methods.description: Provides a plain text listing of server statistics.

methods.name: handler_t mod_status_handle_server_status(request_st * const r,const plugin_data * const p,const plugin_config * const pconf)
methods.description: Main handler that dispatches to HTML, JSON, or text status responses based on URL query.

methods.name: void mod_status_row_append(buffer * b,const char * k,size_t klen,const char * v,size_t vlen)
methods.description: Appends an HTML table row with a key-value pair.

methods.name: void mod_status_header_append(buffer * b,const char * k,size_t klen)
methods.description: Appends an HTML table header with a key.

methods.name: handler_t mod_status_handle_server_config(request_st * const r)
methods.description: Provides a simple page with loaded module names.

methods.name: handler_t mod_status_handler(request_st * const r,void * p_d)
methods.description: Main URI handler that routes status, config, or statistics requests.

methods.name: mod_status_trigger
methods.description: Periodic callback to update traffic and request counts every 5 seconds.

methods.name: mod_status_account
methods.description: Updates counters with data on request completion and bytes written.

methods.name: int mod_status_plugin_init(plugin * p)
methods.description: Initializes the plugin, registering handlers and function pointers.
